text: {"label":"Behavioral Interpretations of Creativity and Aesthetics","definition":"Conceptual and theoretical work offering behavioral accounts of creativity, art, aesthetic responses, emotion, values, and embodied or field-based views of psychological events, including how behavior analysis relates to other disciplines.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike broader debates on behaviorism's history and varieties, operant contrast and variability research, or theory-of-mind analyses, this topic interprets creativity, aesthetics, and complex experience behaviorally."}
